name: Fire escape planner
pitch: Make a fire escape plan and schedule practice drills.
instructions: Start by reading the current layout of the three-bedroom house from a file if it exists. If no layout file is found, ask the person to describe the rooms and windows, then write a simple floor sketch using file_write. Create a page with the escape routes, marking two ways out of each bedroom and the meeting spot outside. When the page is ready, show it to the person using make_page. Next, set up three practice dates in the calendar, one per month, using calendar_create. For each date, pick a weekend morning and write 'Fire drill at [date] – check all windows and doors'. After the calendar is updated, create a routine called 'monthly fire drill' with routine_create that reminds the person one week before each drill. If any tool fails or finds nothing, say plainly what could not be checked and stop.

examples.does: write a floor sketch to a file and show a page with two exits per bedroom
add three weekend mornings to the calendar and create a monthly reminder routine

skills.name: draw-floor-sketch
skills.description: write a simple text-based sketch of the three-bedroom house, label each bedroom, mark every window, and note the outside meeting spot
skills.body: 1. Open the layout file with file_read. 2. If the file is empty or missing, ask the person for the number of windows in each bedroom and the location of the back door. 3. Write a text grid with labels for rooms and windows, and a star for the meeting spot. 4. Save the sketch with file_write. 5. Tell the person the sketch is ready.

skills.name: schedule-drills
skills.description: add three fire drill dates to the calendar and set a routine reminder
skills.body: 1. Use calendar_create to add the first drill one month from today on a weekend morning. 2. Add the second drill two months from today. 3. Add the third drill three months from today. 4. Use routine_create to set a 'monthly fire drill' reminder that runs one week before each date. 5. Confirm the dates and routine with the person.

readme:
# fire escape planner
Creates a fire escape plan for a three-bedroom house and schedules practice drills.
Needs file_write, make_page, calendar_create, routine_create and the calendar connector.
Will not generate a professional fire safety certificate or contact the fire department.
